thread.title: Reading man sentenced to 10 years for fentanyl and methamphetamine trafficking

author: Keystone Today
title: Reading man sentenced to 10 years for fentanyl and methamphetamine trafficking
text:
A resident of Reading, Pennsylvania, was sentenced on May 27 to 120 months in prison and four years of supervised release for conspiracy to distribute and possession with intent to distribute fentanyl and methamphetamine, United States Attorney Troy Rivetti announced.
United States District Judge Stephanie L. Haines imposed the sentence on John Rickenbach Jr., age 44.
According to information presented to the court, from June 2024 through August 2024 in the Western District of Pennsylvania, Rickenbach conspired to distribute and possess with intent to distribute at least 40 grams of a mixture containing fentanyl and at least 50 grams of a mixture containing methamphetamine. In August 2024, Rickenbach distributed and possessed with intent to distribute those amounts.
Assistant United States Attorney Maureen Sheehan-Balchon prosecuted the case for the government.
United States Attorney Rivetti said that the Pennsylvania State Police and the Federal Bureau of Investigation’s Safe Streets Task Force were commended for their work leading to this prosecution.
